text:
olivia: Quick sync — benchmark blog + CEO livestream tomorrow. Need press ops checklist and final social timing. Embargo lifts 09:00 PT, livestream 11:00 PT.
elena: Copy. Press pack link: https://redwood.docs/press/bench-2026.zip (last updated; contains embargo note).
mike: Do we have a short embargo blurb for partners? I can push to syndication list if yes.
sara: Legal cleared the quote snippets at 08:30 PT, but flagged one line about performance claims — removed the percentile callout. Elena, can you confirm updated language in the pack?
elena: Updated that line. I put a note in the press pack: "Performance claims based on internal benchmark; see methodology section."
pressbot: @olivia press outreach scheduled for 09:05 PT to the core list (50 contacts).
olivia: Thanks. Two asks: 1) Social copy schedule (short + long). 2) A fallback headline if last-minute metric tweak is needed.
mike: Draft social plan below. Feel free to copy/edit.
```
09:00 PT — Blog live (link)
09:05 PT — Thread + CEO quote (X, LinkedIn)
09:20 PT — Benchmark explainer video (short)
11:00 PT — CEO livestream reminder (short)
11:05 PT — Live clip posting cadence
```

mike: Fallback headline options: "Redwood publishes benchmark and new tools for inference economics" OR "Redwood publishes updated benchmark; methodology refined"
sam: Ops note — livestream RTMP is green; backup stream ready on zoom-guest in case of CDN hiccup. I'll be monitoring.
olivia: Who's handling live Qs? CEO will take product questions; elena to handle press follow-ups; mike to handle social reply queue.
elena: I'm on press DM triage. If any reporter asks for raw CSVs, route to sara/legal first.
sara: Confirmed — raw data requests go through legal. We can share redacted CSVs after NDA.
mike: One more: do we want a short 2-line script for the CEO to read at start to avoid surprise claims?
olivia: Yes — drafted intro pinned in the pack under /scripts/ceo_opening.txt. Please review.
pressbot: Reminder: embargo time in pack is machine-readable: `embargo: 2026-05-12T16:00:00Z`
sam: I'll post a short ops update in #eng-oncall 10 minutes before stream start.
olivia: Final: can everyone react with :thumbsup: if you can own these pieces?
mike: :thumbsup:
elena: :thumbsup:
sara: :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup:
pressbot: Scheduled reminders will fire at 08:50 PT and 10:50 PT.
olivia: Great — thanks team. If anything changes, update this thread.
